title: Explainer video
summary: Explain a concept, news story, paper or your material so anyone can follow it.
description: Start from the questions viewers actually have, pick the approach that fits the content, and let one concrete subject carry the explanation from start to finish. Every number on screen, in the narration and in the post comes from the same checked set of facts. Each version comes with the video, a cover image and a publish-ready post.
brief: Using {{source material}}, explain {{topic}} to {{audience}} so that afterwards they can {{learning goal}}.

fields.label: source material
fields.hint: Documents, papers, links or text; with none, write "public sources"

fields.label: audience
fields.hint: Who is watching and what they know; blank means viewers with no background

fields.label: topic
fields.hint: A concept, a news story, a paper or a phenomenon

fields.label: learning goal
fields.hint: Retell an idea, follow a news story, make a judgment or try it themselves
fields.example: explain the Moon's phases in their own words

beats: Show the misconception, then overturn it
